Walk onto the beach in Leonida, find a place overlooking the water, order a drink and simply sit back and take it in. The description points to a single specific spot, so treat it as a one-time moment rather than a repeatable objective.
trophies.hint: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

Find a spot with a view of the water
Order a cocktail and sit down
Enjoy the moment for the trophy

With a full playthrough and varied picks you will bank 500 decisions and unlock it.

Pick dialogue and action options as they come up
Vary your decisions rather than repeating
